market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from energy inflation (record US fuel), Canada-US tariff escalation, and Treasury yield pressure at 4.8%. Yen strength and Japan Treasury sales add FX volatility. AI names show resilience (Okta, Salesforce) but OpenAI/MSFT outage creates near-term wobble. Expect 2-4% index volatility over next 2-3 weeks. Defense and energy outperform; consumer discretionary and auto lag.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally intact with Nvidia's first forecast signaling multi-year growth. Defense spending, cybersecurity, and data center infrastructure are secular themes. However, fiscal risk spillover and geopolitical fragmentation (tariffs, wars) cap multiple expansion. 6-12 month: selective equity outperformance in energy, defense, AI-infrastructure, and healthcare; broad market flat-to-modestly-up. Crypto institutionalization accelerates.
